text: seow: "Strength is the signal... top-decile rank." I agree on leadership and the tight coil; SN is the closest of my opposes to a buy. But C16 comes after leadership: day_vol 1.2 is under 1.40, a breakout nobody bought in size, and C9 wants the group's top names where I have it third by rank. What clears me: day_vol 1.40 or more on the next push while within 5% of pivot_high. Then I support.
